```yaml
name: Maintenance Workflow

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Runs at midnight every Sunday

jobs:
  update-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Update category in markdown files
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: "q-a"/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' docs/audit-workflows.md
          sed -i 's/category: Audits/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' docs/portfolio-analyst.md

      - name: Recompile lock files
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Set up GitHub Agentic Workflows
        uses: github/gh-aw/actions/setup@32b3a711a9ee97d38e3989c90af0385aff0066a7
        with:
          destination: .gh-aw
          safe-output-custom-tokens: true

      - name: Create or update discussions
        run: |
          gh-aw create-discussion --model gpt-3.5-turbo --agent agentic-workflows --share false --prompt "Update category in documentation" --use-github-token true --mentions @devantler-tech --variant default --oidc-base-url https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
          gh-aw create-discussion --model gpt-3.5-turbo --agent agentic-workflows --share false --prompt "Recompile lock files" --use-github-token true --mentions @devantler-tech --variant default --oidc-base-url https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
          gh-aw create-discussion --model gpt-3.5-turbo --agent agentic-workflows --share false --prompt "Ensure all agentic workflows write discussions to the Agentic Workflows group" --use-github-token true --mentions @devantler-tech --variant default --oidc-base-url https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Consolidate agentic workflow discussions to single category"
          git push origin main
```
